note: Probes are argv arrays run from the repo root with a 10s budget each. Facts are probed, never guessed.

probes.fact: node is present (the spine is zero-dependency Node)
the three host CLIs in v1 scope are installed
check: command -v claude && command -v codex && command -v opencode

probes.fact: sibling plugin repos the companions.json will pin are cloned
GitHub CLI is authenticated (release to DevOtts/do-it later)
git and python3 for build scripts
the *-it family exists on this machine
no secret-shaped strings in docs/ and delivery/
check: if grep -rIl -E 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|-----BEGIN (RSA|OPENSSH|PRIVATE)|ntn_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}' docs delivery 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; else echo 'no secret patterns'; fi
